state: Owner-signed FPV20 candidate produced and locally verified; public distribution and native-host qualification require their actual accepted records
material_reuse: Existing UR release material; no new cryptographic key is asserted
time_policy: The unchanged verifier compares the signed manifest.created_at (real source commit timestamp), not current wall-clock expiry. No original UR key birthday, activation date or lifetime is asserted.
new_XI_private_representation: The owner-only FPV20 representation was created during the actual 2026-10-21 offline ceremony. No private material is published and no original-material birthday is asserted.

authority_channel.consumer_rule: Pin the actual authority-record commit and formal source commit named in the approved final release record; do not trust mutable main or a commit supplied only by the package.
authority_channel.attestation_basis: Direct release-owner approval of the full preparation/same-host replacement plan and this fixed public fingerprint. Private approval records are retained separately.
authority_channel.administrative_boundary: Authority source and Release may share the same owner GitHub account. This model trusts that canonical owner identity; it does not assert an independent administrative domain or resistance to full owner-account compromise.

formal_release.qualification_status: Owner-signed candidate passed local native macOS verification. Public candidate download may precede Linux qualification; Linux artifact and ordinary installation acceptance are still pending. Do not install before exact Linux qualification and independent acceptance.

revocation: Owner-authenticated status changes are recorded here and in the public trust store. No revocation is asserted in this preparation.
